en.hubeali:
Yunus, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
’ The testimony of the women is allowed regarding (establishment of) the virginity, and every shame which the men cannot look at’.
en.sarwar: 7. Yunus has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Bukayr who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said
testimony of women about virginity and every defect which men cannot look at is admissible.’”
